diplomacyR: Play, Simulate, and Analyse the Board Game Diplomacy

Source: R/diplomacyR-package.R
diplomacyR-package.Rd

A complete engine for the strategic board game Diplomacy, covering the standard seven-power pre-1914 European map. Provides a rules-accurate simultaneous-movement adjudicator (hold, move, support, convoy, retreat, and build phases) validated against the Diplomacy Adjudicator Test Cases, a set of scriptable bots for automated play, batch simulation with outcome analysis, and a comprehensive 'shiny' application for interactive play and exploration. Board states and analyses render as 'ggplot2' objects.
